info.description: 8.38B multimodal embedding model for text and document images, with a 32,768-token context and 4096-dimensional embeddings. Weights use OpenMDW-1.1. The same card lists a Build.NVIDIA.com release of 2026-10-19 and a Hugging Face release of 2026-10-20, so the release date is unset. No request path is printed, and the trial endpoint does not publish a numeric standard price.

zh.description: 8.38B 多模态向量模型，输入为文本和文档图像，上下文 32,768 tokens，向量维度 4096。权重使用 OpenMDW-1.1。同一模型卡同时写了 Build.NVIDIA.com 发布日 2026-10-19 和 Hugging Face 发布日 2026-10-20，因此发布日期留空。页面没有给出请求路径，试用端点也没有数字标准价。
